CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.broadcast_fog_changes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  perform realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'fog:' || coalesce(new.scene_id, old.scene_id)::text,
    TG_OP,
    TG_OP,
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
    NEW,
    OLD
  );
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$function$

policies.policyname: Campaign DMs can delete scene maps
policies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'scene-maps'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] IN ( SELECT (cm.campaign_id)::text AS campaign_id
   FROM campaign_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.role = 'dm'::campaign_role)))))
